finding.title: Rename/relocate completion_button_optimistic_test.dart to presentation/providers/optimistic_completion_provider_test.dart

evidence.quote: // TODO: CompletionButton was removed in the Wave-3/4 refactor.

finding.why: This file imports only a provider (no flutter/material.dart, no pumpWidget, no widget under test anywhere) yet lives at presentation/widgets/ and is named for 'CompletionButton' — a widget that epic_27_story_4_widget_golden_test.dart:240-243 confirms was deleted in the Wave-3/4 refactor. It is the ONLY test in the repo for optimistic_completion_provider.dart (verified: no other test file references optimisticCompletionStateProvider or optimisticKey), so its coverage is real, but AG-5's mirrored-path convention would lead anyone looking for that provider's test to test/features/learning/presentation/providers/optimistic_completion_provider_test.dart and find nothing. Meanwhile the two widgets that actually live in presentation/widgets/ (completion_animation.dart, completion_feedback_controller.dart) have their own separate coverage story (the latter is tested via test/story_acceptance/epic_08_gamification_test.dart) — this file's presence in that directory adds no signal about them and is pure historical debris.
finding.recommendation: git mv to test/features/learning/presentation/providers/optimistic_completion_provider_test.dart; rename the file to drop the 'completion_button' name that refers to deleted code.
acceptance_criteria: No file under test/ contains 'completion_button' in its name unless a CompletionButton widget exists in lib/

finding.title: Extract a shared pump helper in learning_screen_l1_test.dart instead of 4 inline MaterialApp/localizationsDelegates blocks

evidence.quote:
ProviderScope(
          retry: (_, __) => null, // disable retry so error state persists

finding.why: The R6-4 AsyncLoading test, the R6-4 AsyncError test, and the E4 regression test each re-declare their own ProviderScope + MaterialApp + the full 4-delegate localizationsDelegates list inline instead of extending _buildScreen (which already exists in the same file) with a streakStream/router parameter. Any future change to the delegates list or supportedLocales must be replicated across 4 places in this one file; the pattern in test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart (pumpApp(...)) shows the repo already knows how to centralize this, it just isn't used at the widget-test tier.
finding.recommendation: Add optional streakStream and router parameters to _buildScreen and route all 4 call sites through it, or adopt a shared test/helpers/pump_app.dart per TQ-3's stated convention.
acceptance_criteria: localizationsDelegates/supportedLocales list appears exactly once in learning_screen_l1_test.dart
All testWidgets in the file that pump LearningScreen go through _buildScreen or a shared helper

finding.title: Remove duplicate TutorPermissions invariant tests from learning_screen_l1_test.dart — already covered in ws3_3d_tutor_permissions_surface_test.dart

evidence.quote:
test(
    'PRODUCT INVARIANT: TutorPermissions VO always enforces canMarkLiveCompletion=false',

test(
    'PRODUCT INVARIANT: TutoredProfileSelection.permissions always has canMarkLiveCompletion=false',

finding.why: These two `test(...)` blocks (not testWidgets — no LearningScreen is ever pumped) construct TutorPermissions/TutoredProfileSelection directly and assert canMarkLiveCompletion is always false. The file's own comments (lines 13-16, 455-457) admit LearningScreen doesn't enforce this invariant at all — TextDisplayScreen does. The identical assertion (perms.canMarkLiveCompletion, isFalse against the same constructor/defaults/copyWith surface) already exists in test/features/tutoring/ws3_3d_tutor_permissions_surface_test.dart:202,217. Placed here, they add no unique protection, cost double maintenance if TutorPermissions' constructor changes, and could mislead a reviewer into thinking LearningScreen is where this security-relevant invariant is guarded.
finding.recommendation: Delete tests 8/8b from learning_screen_l1_test.dart; if screen-level reassurance is wanted, replace with a genuine widget-level assertion that no live-mark affordance renders in LearningScreen during an active tutor session.
acceptance_criteria: learning_screen_l1_test.dart contains no plain test(...) block (only testWidgets) asserting TutorPermissions/TutoredProfileSelection VO state
test/features/tutoring/ws3_3d_tutor_permissions_surface_test.dart remains the single source of truth for the canMarkLiveCompletion invariant

finding.title: Split learning_screen_l1_test.dart (1021 lines) — exceeds AG-3's 400-line hand-written-file cap by 2.5x
finding.why: 1021 lines (wc -l confirmed) against AG-3's 400-line cap for hand-written Dart files — no test exemption is stated for AG-3 (only AG-5's mirroring rule exempts story_acceptance). The file's own header comment already documents 19 numbered logical groups (loading/error/empty-state/data-state/daily-tasks/icons/RTL/R6-4 regression/E4 regression), a ready-made split boundary.
finding.recommendation: Split along the file's own documented section numbers, e.g. learning_screen_state_test.dart (loading/error/empty/data), learning_screen_daily_tasks_test.dart (daily-tasks + icons), learning_screen_regressions_test.dart (R6-4, E4, Hebrew smoke), each sharing _buildScreen via a small test-only library part or helper file.
acceptance_criteria: No hand-written file under test/features/learning/presentation/screens/ exceeds 400 lines
Total test count and assertions are preserved across the split (no `weaken-ok` markers needed since nothing is removed, only relocated)

finding.title: Move test/features/learning_order/** to mirror lib/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/** per AG-5
finding.why: lib/features/learning_order/ was deleted and its canonical replacement moved to lib/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/ in commit 43b6de92 ('delete duplicate feature trees', 2026-05-20) — every symbol these 3 test files import now lives under lib/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/, but the test directory was never renamed to match. Three weeks later, commit bd2c985c (2026-06-11) added a brand-new test file (learning_order_screen_reset_test.dart) still under the stale test/features/learning_order/ path, proving the drift keeps compounding rather than being a one-time leftover. A developer following AG-5 mirroring to find existing coverage for lib/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/ (or to place a new test) would look in test/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/, find nothing, and risk writing duplicate tests; the same stale-directory pattern independently affects test/features/track_learning_order/ (a different batch's file, corroborating this is a repeated refactor gap, not a one-off).
finding.recommendation: git mv the 3 files to test/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/{data/repositories,presentation/screens}/..., recalculating the relative ../../../../helpers/... import depth for the new nesting level, and remove the now-empty test/features/learning_order/ directory.
acceptance_criteria: test/features/learning_order/ no longer exists; its 3 files live under test/features/tracks/whole_curriculum_order/ at paths mirroring their lib/ counterparts 1:1 (AG-5).
Relative helper imports (drift_memory.dart) are corrected for the new nesting depth and `flutter test` passes unchanged from the old location.
